description: 功能清单原子。调度器靠它选任务,验证器靠它判完成,交接器靠它生成报告。来源:Learn Harness Engineering 第 8 讲。

features.behavior: CLI export --source workbuddy 能从 WorkBuddy 本地数据导出会话到 raw/*.json,包含 turn 重组、PII 脱敏、增量导出
features.verification: uv run agent-memory-exporter export --source workbuddy --limit 3 && ls agent_export/raw/*.json | head -1 && uv run agent-memory-exporter validate
features.evidence: commit 1e0beb3: 36 tests passing, 3 real WorkBuddy sessions exported, schema validation passed

features.behavior: OpenCode adapter: --source opencode 能从 OpenCode 本地 DB 导出会话,与 WorkBuddy adapter 接口一致
features.verification: uv run agent-memory-exporter export --source opencode --limit 3 && ls agent_export/raw/*.json | head -1
features.evidence: 44 tests passing; uv run agent-memory-exporter export --source opencode --limit 3 → 3 exported, 0 errors; validate → 3 valid, 0 invalid; status → 3 sessions, 0 gaps

features.behavior: MCP Server export 工具:通过 MCP 协议触发 CLI 导出,支持 source/since/full 参数
features.verification: MCP 客户端调用 export 工具,返回 {exported, skipped, errors}
features.evidence: 51 tests passing; MCP export tool end-to-end: 3 WorkBuddy sessions exported via ExportTool.run(); server create_server() with tools/list + tools/call handlers; tool definition with source/incremental/full/limit/no_redact params

features.behavior: MCP Server clean 工具:读取 raw/*.json,LLM 过滤清洗,输出 processed/*.md,每条打 quality 标签(high/medium/low/trash),trash 不入库
features.verification: MCP 客户端调用 clean 工具,检查 agent_export/processed/*.md 已生成且含 quality 标签
features.evidence: 73 tests passing; clean_tool.py with LLMClient (OpenAI-compatible, httpx), clean_prompt.md system prompt, parse_llm_response (JSON with fence/extra-text fallback), build_processed_markdown (YAML front-matter with quality/source/session_id/cleaned_at/title); 22 new tests covering parse_llm_response (8), session_to_user_prompt (2), build_processed_markdown (2), CleanTool.run (10: high/trash/skip/force/limit/no_raw_dir/multi_quality/llm_error/model_recorded); E2E: export 2 real WorkBuddy sessions → clean with mock LLM → 2 processed/*.md with quality:medium front-matter; server.py registers both export + clean tools

features.behavior: MCP Server ingest 工具:读取 processed/*.md(仅 high/medium),调用 WeKnora HTTP API 入库到 Source-KB
features.verification: MCP 客户端调用 ingest 工具,返回 {ingested, failed, kb_id},WeKnora list_knowledge 确认入库,trash 条目不入库

features.behavior: Auto-Wiki 蒸馏:cron 每周增量蒸馏 Source-KB 新条目,LLM 聚类+关键词 slug 生成稳定 topic_id,比较后选优覆盖已有 wiki,provenance 记录来源 session ID,写入独立 Auto-Wiki KB
features.verification: wiki 条目数 > 0 且每个条目有 provenance 字段包含来源 session ID;重复运行蒸馏不产生重复 wiki 条目;distill_state.json 的 processed_knowledge_ids 只增不减

state_legend.passing: 验证通过,已完成(唯一不可逆状态)

rules.state_transition: not_started -> active -> passing(验证通过才可升级); active -> blocked(依赖问题); blocked -> active(阻塞解除); passing 不可回退
rules.evidence_required: state 为 passing 时,evidence 必须填写 commit hash 或测试输出日志
rules.agent_cannot_self_mark_passing: agent 不能直接把状态改成 passing,只能由验证命令执行结果决定
